subject: Sprint stitch: coverage velocity check & stage refresh
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sophie Hale <sophie@orioncloud.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sprint stitch: coverage velocity check & stage refresh

Team / Sophie —

Quick check-in ahead of next week’s forecast lock. Finance asked us for a concise picture of coverage velocity against Q4 target for Orion Cloud (deal 8421) so they can model downside scenarios. I attached a current snapshot (pipeline_snapshot_q3.xlsx) and a blank runbook.

Asks:  
- Internal: can each owner confirm stage-level movement expected this quarter (A-B-C-D) and call out any likely net-new conversion we should count vs contingent? Please reply with numbers and timing.
- External (Sophie): can you confirm gating items and whether the cloud compliance review will land this month? That timing materially affects our close pattern.

Priority: we need a single-screen view to feed finance by EOD Tuesday so they can run two downside models. If anyone expects a commit change > 20% from current snapshot, flag here so we can reassign coverage.

Thanks — short and tactical preferred.

— Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Mid Market
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Hale <sophie@orioncloud.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Orion Cloud Sales <orioncloud-sales@orioncloud.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint stitch: coverage velocity check & stage refresh

Avery —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick update from our side:
- Compliance review: on track, final evidence request is scheduled for 9/20. No blockers today.
- Procurement: procurement lead is on vacation 9/13–9/17, so contract redlines will likely slip until 9/22.
- Budget timing: finance confirmed a reforecast window the week of 9/27; they prefer to see a firm close date by then.

Numbers: current committed ARR in our pipeline is $420k (we showed the spreadsheet to finance this morning). We expect a conservative conversion of $210k by end of Sep if compliance clears on 9/20 and procurement completes redlines by 9/24. If procurement slips beyond 9/24 we should assume a Q4 push.

Happy to jump on a 15m tomorrow to walk through the gating items with your team.

— Sophie
Sophie Hale
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Orion Cloud

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint stitch: coverage velocity check & stage refresh

Avery / Laura —

I ran a quick pass on the attached pipeline_snapshot_q3.xlsx and annotated expected stage movement:
- A (Negotiation): $260k — 60% probability; expect two deals to finalize by 9/30 (net +$190k recognized as realistic).
- B (Legal review): $110k — 30% probability; procurement windows introduce 2–3 week risk.
- C (Proof of concept): $30k — low conversion without exec sign-off, treat as upside.

Net conservative coverage to quota from this set: $200k. That’s ~48% of the $420k we currently show; gap to target (finance target = $420k -> but we need 100% commit to hit quota) remains.

Action items I recommend:
1) Prioritize A deals for CE and AE time to remove blocking items this week.
2) Move the highest-velocity B deal into a canary legal path (template redline we can accept).
3) Add a $80k contingency from pipeline adjacent accounts to shortfall plan (I’ve pulled 2 prospects for outreach).

I can push an updated snapshot by EOD with the annotated column and a suggested commit number for finance.

— Marcus
Director, Sales Ops

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sophie Hale <sophie@orioncloud.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint stitch: coverage velocity check & stage refresh

Thanks Marcus / Sophie — useful color. A few clarifying points from the forecast side:

- Finance prefers a single committed number per deal rather than probabilities. For our submission we should present a conservative commit and a stretch commit.
- For DEAL-8421 specifically, mark the $190k as committed (A) if we have both procurement timeline <= 9/24 and SOC evidence signoff. If either slips, we should downgrade to stretch.

Immediate next steps:
- Avery: please update the "commit" column in the attached snapshot with your recommended committed value per deal and mark any dependency/assignee (e.g., legal, CE).
- Marcus: please include the contingency list as a single line item (name + estimated ARR) so finance can include it as mitigant.
- Sophie: if you can confirm the procurement point of contact and whether they will accept our template redlines, that will speed the legal move.

I’ll collate everything and send the finance submission by EOD Tuesday. If anyone needs help with phrasing for the submission, ping me.

— Laura
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Hale <sophie@orioncloud.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint stitch: coverage velocity check & stage refresh

All —

Thanks for the quick responses. Short update on actions I pushed this morning:
- Updated pipeline_snapshot_q3.xlsx: I set committed values for the two A deals (combined $190k) and added notes tying them to SOC evidence (Sophie to confirm on 9/20). File saved as pipeline_snapshot_q3_v2.xlsx (attached).
- Added the contingency line Marcus suggested: "Regional Upside (contingency) — $80k — follow-up owner: Avery".
- Scheduled a 15m sync with Sophie and our legal lead for 9/15 09:30 PT to try and compress procurement redline work.

A couple of asks before I lock the finance submission:
1) Laura — can you confirm the format you want for conservative vs stretch (single column vs two columns)? I can conform quickly.
2) Marcus — please send the contingency names with ARR estimates by 2pm today so I can add them to the snapshot.

If I don’t hear objections I’ll finalize and submit Tuesday EOD.

Attachments: pipeline_snapshot_q3_v2.xlsx, commit_runbook_template.docx

— Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Mid Market
Redwood Inference
